references.text: The same principle of not mixing different things, including the prohibition against sowing a field with two kinds of seed
Continuation of the laws about not mixing different things—plowing with an ox and a donkey together, and garments made of wool and linen
Paul uses the principle of not mixing different things as a metaphor that believers should not be yoked together with unbelievers
Jesus' parable of the wheat and the weeds addresses the theme of mixing in the field, but from an eschatological perspective
